messages.subject: Height measurment error
messages.body_plain:
Hi
I am just starting to use FieldImageR and are running through the tutorial.
When I am trying to run the height measurment code I get the following message
> # Removing the soil using mask from step 4: > CHM.S <- fieldMask(CHM.R, mask = EX1.RemSoil$mask) [1] "1 layers available" Error in .local(x, y, ...) : extents do not overlap

Is there something wrong earlier when I made the remove soil example?
Kind regard
Martin

messages.subject: Re: Height measurment error
messages.body_plain:
Hey Martin,

How´s going?

It seems  CHM.R  and EX1.RemSoil$mask does not have the same extension or maybe they are not on the same lat and long. Could you check their crs() or resolution() and let us know?

All the best,
Filipe

Hi Filipe
I am not shure how I check the crs() and Resolution on the CHM.R and EX1.RemSoil$mask.
I have just followed your excelent tutorial and untill the height measurement part it is working fine.
I have checked the ortophoto in QGIS and it looks like EX1_RGB.tif, EX_DSM0.tif and DSM1.tif is placed in the same spot.

But I think I have to work alittle more with the code to fully understand what is going on :-)
I think the program is very usefull untill now, but I need to work more with it. (dose it have a function where you could ask it to leave out X cm arround all plots to try to avoid border effect)

Regards
Martin
